purpose: Offline readable source mirror; not a runtime patch
namingPolicy: Confirmed role plus original spelling; unknown symbols stay unchanged. Parameter keys use zero-based source parameter positions. Local rules use declaration ordinals and require the original spelling as an additional guard; reused locals retain both roles in the name. Screen IDs and action IDs remain numeric; decompiler control-flow state is not treated as gameplay state.
